SUPERIOR COURT OF THE STATE OF WESTBROOK, COUNTY OF MARION

JORDAN K. PARRISH,
                Plaintiff,
        v.                              Case No. CV-2024-08877
NORTHRIDGE LOGISTICS, INC.;
ETHAN M. BRAY,
                Defendants.

COMPLAINT FOR DAMAGES — NEGLIGENCE

Plaintiff JORDAN K. PARRISH alleges:

1. On August 4, 2024, at approximately 7:42 a.m., Plaintiff was operating a 2021 Honda Civic eastbound on Westbrook State Route 9 near mile marker 14.
2. Defendant ETHAN M. BRAY was operating a 2022 Freightliner Cascadia tractor-trailer in the course and scope of his employment with Defendant NORTHRIDGE LOGISTICS, INC.
3. Defendant Bray, traveling eastbound in the lane to Plaintiff's left, attempted to change lanes into Plaintiff's lane without signaling. The right front of the tractor-trailer struck the left rear quarter panel of Plaintiff's vehicle, causing Plaintiff's vehicle to spin 180 degrees and strike the concrete center barrier.
4. Plaintiff sustained the following injuries:
   a. Comminuted fracture of L tibial plateau requiring ORIF;
   b. Three rib fractures (L 6, 7, 8);
   c. Moderate traumatic brain injury (GCS 13 at scene, confirmed by neuroimaging);
   d. Lumbar disc herniation at L4-L5;
   e. Acute stress disorder, ongoing.
5. Defendant Bray was cited at the scene for unsafe lane change (Westbrook Vehicle Code § 22107).
6. Defendant Bray's logbook records, produced post-incident, indicate he had been on-duty for 11 hours and 22 minutes at the time of the collision, exceeding the FMCSA 11-hour driving limit (49 C.F.R. § 395.3(a)(3)).
7. Defendant Northridge Logistics is vicariously liable under respondeat superior and directly liable for negligent supervision and negligent enforcement of hours-of-service regulations.

DAMAGES:
- Medical specials to date: $312,400
- Future medical (life care plan): $1,180,000 (see Ex. F)
- Lost wages (4 months out of work): $42,800
- Loss of earning capacity: $640,000 (vocational expert report, Ex. G)
- Pain and suffering, loss of enjoyment of life.

JURY TRIAL DEMANDED.

Dated: October 17, 2024
                                /s/ D. Verma, Esq.
